input.summary: Retain the Section 4.2(a) computation verbatim and add a new 4.2(d) capping the Termination Payment at three months' Section 3.1 fees as the Company's sole early-termination fee and sole liquidated amount.
input.comment: [Playbook] We left the Section 4.2(a) calculation and the 4.2(b)-(c) mechanics untouched and added a new 4.2(d) capping the Termination Payment at three months' fees and confirming it is our only early-termination fee and sole liquidated amount. Our preferred position is no Customer-payable liquidated amount, but we can accept this cap.

ops.text: The Termination Payment shall not exceed the fees payable by the Company pursuant to Section 3.1 for the three (3) months preceding the Termination Date, and shall be the Company's sole early termination fee and the sole liquidated amount payable by the Company under this Agreement.
